entries.land_location_as_stated: End of #10 Rd; surrounded by hundreds of other acres of forest in central Maine
entries.description: Private land of 30 acres in central Maine lived on by two lesbian women and an 11-year-old girl child. It is chemical-free and raises much of its own food with horses, chickens, ducks, and gardens. It has housing, plumbing, electricity, and camping space, hosts monthly full moon celebrations, and welcomes lesbian women, non-lesbian women, and girl children.
entries.raw_text: GATHERING GROUND c/o Linda & Carol, RFD 2, Box 3085, Dexter, ME 04930 (207)924-5172 (End of #10 Rd). We are two (sometimes more) lesbians living on 30 acres surrounded by hundreds of other acres of forest in central Maine. We are chemical free. We share space with Carol's 11-year-old daughter, 3 horses, 10 chickens, 3 ducks, 6 cats and 1 dog. We grow much of our own food. Lesbians are welcome to camp on our land whenever and for as long as they like. They must be self-sufficient and carry all trash out and leave camping space as they found it. We have full moon celebrations on Sat evening closest to full moon every month - all lesbians welcome to share/join us. We welcome: girl children, nonlesbian women. We have/are: 2 lesbians, 1 nonlesbian, 30 acres, housing/permanent structures, plumbing/electricity, camping space, woods, slowly clearing farmland, women living and working on the land.

entries.land_location_as_stated: tucked away in the woods of Central Maine
entries.description: A 10-acre homestead in the woods of central Maine where one lesbian woman lives off the grid, raising doe goats, gardening, and making cheese. Has 2 permanent structures, camping space, woods, and farmland, and welcomes new residents, lesbian women, non-lesbian women (maybe), and girl children.
entries.raw_text: CHRIS OF COVENTREE PO Box 16, Troy, ME 04987. A sanctuary for women, plants, animals. I started homesteading on a ten acre piece of land tucked away in the woods of Central Maine summer of '81. Doe goats, cats, a dog and sometimes other lesbians have shared this homeland with me. I carry my water, plant and preserve the food I grow in my garden and the cheese I make, heat with firewood I mostly cut myself, build with scrap lumber. I welcome: new members/residents, girl children, nonlesbian women (maybe). I have/am: 1 lesbian, 10 acres, 2 housing/permanent structures, camping space, woods, farmland, women living and working on the land.

entries.land_location_as_stated: Located between Albany and Binghamton, NY on Steiber Rd
entries.description: Thirty acres in Stamford, New York with an old house, plumbing, electricity, woods, and primitive camping space by a stream. One lesbian woman lives on the land (with her two college-age sons living there part-time). Welcomes lesbian women as visitors or new residents, girl children (maybe), and boy children under 10 to visit; prohibits hard drugs, guns, and heavy drinking.
entries.raw_text: DEER SONG c/o Maggie Laird, RD Box 99, Stamford, NY 12167 (607)652-5057(weekends only). Located between Albany and Binghamton, NY on Steiber Rd. Lesbian couples have stayed here and love the peaceful quiet. 30 miles to a lesbian support group. For now, my two college age sons are part-time dwellers, also dogs and cats. One spare bedroom so Winter is not best for staying. I welcome: new members/residents, girl children (maybe), boy children under 10 to visit, dogs on leash. Please, no hard drugs, guns or heavy drinking. Bring your own groceries. Donations appreciated but not necessary. I have/am: 1 lesbian, 2 nonlesbians, 30 acres, old house, plumbing/electricity, primitive camping space with stream, lots of woods, possible farmland, woman living and working on the land.

entries.description: A 50-acre working homestead and educational center near Woodstock in Saugerties, New York, maintained as separatist space for women since 1978, with 2 lesbian women and 2 non-lesbian women living on the land. It has goats, poultry, fruit, vegetable and herb gardens, a solar greenhouse, permanent housing, and camping space, and offers herbal medicine and spirit healing workshops, intensives, and apprenticeships to lesbian women, non-lesbian women, and girl children.
entries.raw_text: LAUGHING ROCK FARM/WISE WOMAN CENTER c/o Susun Weed, 3136 Fishcreek, Saugerties, NY 12477 (near Woodstock). Laughing Rock Farm is safe space for womyn. Maintained as separatist land for 8 years (since '78), Laughing Rock (formerly Rowdybush) is a working homestead with goats, ducks, geese, chickens, cats, fruit, veg and herb gardens, lots of private (clothes off) playing and swimming places, solar greenhouse, and a trillion tons of rock. It is our belief that all womyn (lesbians or not) need separatist space for healing; we offer it, on short-term basis. The Wise Woman Center, offers herbal medicine and spirit healing workshops, intensives, and apprenticeships. We welcome: girl children, nonlesbian women. We have/are: 2 lesbians, 2 nonlesbians, 50 acres, housing/permanent structures, plumbing/electricity, camping space, woods, women living and working on the land.
entries.notes: Type is Retreat/Gathering Space: Wise Woman Center is an educational/healing center offering short-term healing space, workshops, intensives, and apprenticeships ('we offer it, on short-term basis. The Wise Woman Center, offers herbal medicine and spirit healing workshops, intensives, and apprenticeships'), as well as a working homestead with 4 residents ('2 lesbians, 2 nonlesbians... women living and working on the land'). Land address copied from street address ('3136 Fishcreek, Saugerties, NY 12477'). entries.community_name: SENECA WOMEN'S ENCAMPMENT FOR A FUTURE OF PEACE & JUSTICE
entries.description: A 53-acre feminist peace encampment and collective community outside the Seneca Army Depot in Romulus, New York. Many lesbian women and non-lesbian women live and work on the land, which has wheelchair-accessible permanent structures, chemical-free spaces, electricity, woods, and camping space. It welcomes lesbian women, non-lesbian women, girl children, and boy children for short and long-term stays.
entries.raw_text: SENECA WOMEN'S ENCAMPMENT FOR A FUTURE OF PEACE & JUSTICE 5440 Rt 96, Romulus, NY 14541 (607)869-5825. We are a permanent vigil for peace and justice outside the Seneca Army Depot, the largest nuclear weapons storage site in the world. We are an open, constantly changing, feminist community struggling to overcome oppression and militarism both outside our community and within it. We welcome all women who respect our commitment to non-violence and consensus process for short and long-term stays. Work is done collectively, and all meals are communal and vegetarian. All permanent structures are wheelchair accessible, and there are chem-free spaces on the land. We welcome: new members/residents, girl & boy children, nonlesbian women. We have/are: many lesbians and nonlesbians, 53 acres, housing/permanent structures, electricity, woods, camping space, women living and working on the land.
entries.notes: Type is Intentional Community/Cooperative ('feminist community... consensus process... Work is done collectively, and all meals are communal', 'women living and working on the land'). Land address copied from route address ('5440 Rt 96, Romulus, NY 14541'). Residents left blank because no number is given ('many lesbians and nonlesbians'). Focuses: Disabled women ('All permanent structures are wheelchair accessible'), Environmentalism/eco-friendly ('there are chem-free spaces on the land').

entries.description: An intentional community of 4 lesbian women on 35 acres (25 acres of woods) in Freeland, Maryland, with 5 buildings, conference center facilities, a solar greenhouse, and 20-year organic gardens. Welcomes new residents, lesbian women, non-lesbian women, and girl children, and is drug-free.
entries.raw_text: HEATHCOTE COMMUNITY 21300 Heathcote Rd, Freeland, MD 21053 (301)343-0280 (35 miles from Baltimore). We are presently 4 lesbians, down from 7 over the summer. We are in big transitions, and are hoping to focus our energies this winter to achieve some concrete goals. Right now it feels like everything is up in the air. Miscommunication is a common theme in our lives and we're struggling for ways to live harmoniously as a group instead of as separate individuals "tolerating" each other. We welcome: new members/residents, girl children, nonlesbian women. We're not into drugs. We have/are: 4 lesbians, 35 acres, 5 buildings, conference center facilities, solar greenhouse, plumbing/electricity, camping space, woods (25 acres), limited farmland, a lot of gardens - 20 years organic, friendly neighbors, women working the land, an inactive group with hopes to revive.

entries.description: Twenty acres in Unger, West Virginia where 2 lesbian women live in an owner-built passive-solar home, run a consulting and woodworking business, and sponsor semi-annual women-only concerts. Has 1 house, 1 permanent structure, woods, and unlimited camping space, and welcomes lesbian women, non-lesbian women, gay men, and non-gay men, with no drugs, moderate alcohol, and smoking restrictions.
entries.raw_text: GREENSTALK c/o Nan or Ruth, South Morgan Dr, Box 65, Berkeley Springs, WV 25411 (304)258-5079 (Unger, WV). In 1982, construction of an owner-built, passive-solar home began and is nearing completion. We're musicians and sponsor women-only concerts every June and Sept as Rural Women's Productions. We run a consulting and woodworking business. We welcome: nonlesbian women, males. No drugs, moderate alcohol, smoking restrictions, bring food to share. We have/are: 2 lesbians, 20 acres, 1 house, 1 permanent structure, plumbing/electricity, unlimited camping space, woods, women living on the land.

entries.description: Fifty acres of hardwoods, pines, and 3 fields with one finished house in rural Pittsboro, North Carolina. The owner is looking for other lesbian women to build houses and live on the land, or is open to selling 5-10 acres.
entries.raw_text: HERLAND c/o Duffy Z Baum, PO Box 678, Carrboro, NC 27510 (919)942-5340 (Located in rural Pittsboro, NC). The property is a mixture of hardwoods and pines with 3 fields and one finished house on 50 acres. I am interested in having other women build houses and live on the land. I am also open to selling 5-10 acres. There is a large, active lesbian political community about 35 miles away in Durham. Herland is about 35 miles from Raleigh and 20 miles from Chapel Hill.
